issues.title: No way forward without a profile
issues.detail: The `else` only covers "not signed in". A signed-in user with no profile row falls through both checks and is left on the opening screen, which has nothing to tap. This is exactly the state an abandoned sign-up leaves behind.

issues.title: Evening events are saved a day late
issues.detail: The date is taken from the UTC version of the start time and the time from the local version. Any start time that is already past midnight in UTC — 7 pm or later in Illinois in summer time, 6 pm in winter — is saved under the next day.

issues.title: Every edit moves an evening event again
issues.detail: The edit screen reads the saved date and time back as local time, then saves them with the same UTC cut. Each Update tap on an evening event pushes it one more day forward, even if nothing was changed.

issues.title: Preview shows the day before
issues.detail: `new Date("2026-10-22")` is midnight UTC, which is the previous evening in the Americas, so the weekday and date on the preview and details screens are one day early for any correctly saved event.

issues.title: Picking the date after the time resets it
issues.detail: The calendar keeps the time of day from when the form was opened and replaces the whole start value. Choosing the time first and the date second loses the chosen start time; the Time field then shows the wrong hour.
